extracted.intended_audience: University of Kent researchers and KAR repository administrators who are adding or checking author contribution metadata
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for recording CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) contributor roles for authors in the University of Kent Research (KAR) repository, including when and how to add roles and optional contribution-degree modifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conceptualization
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the 14 CRediT contributor roles listed by the taxonomy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors submitting to publishers that participate in CRediT will be asked to describe their individual contributions using these roles; the CRediT descriptions will be published alongside the article. Multiple CRediT roles can be applied to one author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aims of CRediT: standardized, transparent approach to authorship
rubrics_metrics.description: CRediT provides a more open, standardized and transparent approach to authorship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CRediT to make authorship roles clearer and more consistent across publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aims of CRediT: ensure appropriate credit across contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensures that all contributors receive appropriate credit for their work across all aspects of research including writing, data curation and statistical analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record all relevant contributor roles so contributors receive recognition beyond traditional authorship ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aims of CRediT: enable equality, diversity and inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Enables Equality, Diversity and Inclusivity by recognising all contributors regardless of status or any other characteristic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include roles for contributors at all levels of seniority to support inclusive recognition practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aims of CRediT: reduce ambiguity and conflicts regarding authorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduces ambiguity and potential conflicts regarding authorship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the standardized role labels to avoid disputes over who did what; supply the roles as published by the publisher where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher adoption caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: Not all publishers are using the CRediT taxonomy; Kent notes a list of adopters of CRediT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only add CRediT information to KAR when it appears on the publisher's published article page; check the publisher's adoption status before adding roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: KAR inclusion policy for CRediT
rubrics_metrics.description: KAR will only add CRediT information to an entry when it is present in the published article on the publisher page and when the roles used on the published article are as stated in the CRediT taxonomy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not invent or normalize roles that differ from those shown on the publisher page; ensure role labels match the official taxonomy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display of CRediT and ORCID in KAR author information
rubrics_metrics.description: For each article an author information section on the KAR landing page displays CRediT and ORCID information for the Kent author, when this information is present in the KAR record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that the KAR bibliographic/person details are populated so the KAR landing page can show CRediT and ORCID.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to add CRediT details in KAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the 'person details' section in the 'Bibliographic description' page in KAR to define CRediT roles for each author of an article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the KAR UI path: Bibliographic description -> person details. Populate roles only if they appear on the publisher page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree-of-contribution modifiers (lead/equal/supporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where multiple individuals serve in the same role, the degree of contribution can be specified as ‘lead’, ‘equal’, or ‘supporting’. This is optional and is not yet adopted by many publishers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only add these degree modifiers in KAR if the same information is present on the publisher page; do not add them otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow multiple CRediT roles per author
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple CRediT roles can be applied to one author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assign every role an author actually performed as shown on the publisher page; do not limit authors to a single role if they performed multiple activities.
